script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let currentParamId be part → get-current-param-id.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of part.
Set the register's 'currBpIdx' to the phase for part under the phases list3 with HP fraction hpRate from phase the register's 'currBpIdx'.
If currentParamId is the stat block of form "1" on part and hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_to_cid_phase_2" in the battle settings of the enemy, then
  Run helper2.
  Part changes to stat block the stat block of form "2" on part.
  Part cancels its cast and stop.
If currentParamId is the stat block of form "2" on part, then
  If part 2 of the acting enemy is alive, then stop.
  Run helper3.
Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form list3 at (the register's 'currBpIdx')'s 'paramSuffixNo' on part.
If currentParamId is not paramIdBySuffixNo, then
  Part changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  Part cancels its cast.

script_hooks.logic:
Let part be part 1 of the acting enemy.
Let list4 be [].
Append [{messageSuffixNo: "01"}] to list4.
Set list4 to list4 → concat with (a revive sequence {nos: [2], deformTag: "deformation_01", filteringDeformPosArray: [1, 2]}).
Append [{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: list2, saChildNos: [2]}] to list4.
List4 → push with ([{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: [the INVINCIBLE status], saChildNos: [1]}], [{deformTag: "deformation_02", skipEnemyName: true}]).
Append [{messageSuffixNo: "02"}] to list4.
Part uses the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI immediately with options {sequence: list4} and timing {interruptBeforeCounter: true}.
